europe_now.title: Polish far-right leader charged with Holocaust denial
europe_now.summary: A Polish far-right leader has been charged with Holocaust denial for describing Auschwitz gas chambers as 'fake'. This case highlights ongoing societal tensions in Poland regarding historical narratives.

top_stories.title: Poland implements regulation recognizing foreign same-sex marriages
top_stories.summary: Poland has introduced a regulation that recognizes same-sex marriages performed in other countries. This policy change reflects evolving societal attitudes within the EU member state.

top_stories.title: Saudi Arabia invests in French theme park project
top_stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has committed €6 billion to develop a new manga-themed amusement park near Paris. This investment strengthens bilateral cooperation between Saudi Arabia and France.
